                                                                                                                      • When gypsum is heated to 373 K, it loses water molecules and forms plaster of Paris, which has the formula \\(\\text{CaSO}_4 \\cdot \\frac{1}{2}\\text{H}_2\\text{O}\\).
                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                      • This process is known as the calcination of gypsum.
                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                      • The obtained compound, plaster of Paris, is a white powder that hardens when mixed with water.
                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                      • Plaster of Paris is widely used in construction, medical applications (for making casts), and art.

"solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                          Relative Speed when moving towards each other = 12 + 14 = 26 km/h.

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Total distance to be reduced = 56 − 4 = 52 km.

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Time required = Distance covered ÷ Relative Speed = 52 ÷ 26 = 2 hr.

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 2 hr.

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Total distance between two places = 56 km

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Speed of the first person (S1) = 12 km/h

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Speed of the second person (S2) = 14 km/h

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Required gap between them = 4 km

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Relative Speed (Opposite direction) = S1 + S2

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Calculations:

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          ⇒ Total initial distance = 56 km

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          ⇒ Target distance apart = 4 km

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          ⇒ Effective distance covered by both = 56 − 4 = 52 km

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          ⇒ Relative Speed = 12 + 14 = 26 km/h

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          ⇒ Time taken = 52 ÷ 26 = 2 hr

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          ∴ The correct answer is 2 hr.

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Relative Speed in Opposite Direction

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          When two objects move toward each other or away from each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S1 + S2).

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Relative Speed in Same Direction

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference between their individual speeds (S1 − S2).

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          Time of Meeting

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          The time taken to meet is calculated as Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed, provided they start at the same time. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                          एक-दूसरे की ओर चलते समय सापेक्ष गति (Relative Speed) = 12 + 14 = 26 किमी/घंटा।

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          कम की जाने वाली कुल दूरी = 56 − 4 = 52 किमी।

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          आवश्यक समय = तय की गई दूरी ÷ सापेक्ष गति = 52 ÷ 26 = 2 घंटे।

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          ∴ सही उत्तर 2 घंटे है।

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          Alternate Method

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          दो स्थानों के बीच की कुल दूरी = 56 किमी

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          पहले व्यक्ति की गति (S1) = 12 किमी/घंटा

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          दूसरे व्यक्ति की गति (S2) = 14 किमी/घंटा

                                                                                                                          \n

                                                                                                                          उनके बीच", "te": "

                                                                                                                          ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          రెండు ప్రదేశాల మధ్య దూరం = 56 కి.మీ

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          మొదటి వ్యక్తి వేగం = 12 కి.మీ/గంట

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          రెండవ వ్యక్తి వేగం = 14 కి.మీ/గంట

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          సాపేక్ష వేగం = మొదటి వ్యక్తి వేగం + రెండవ వ్యక్తి వేగం

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          సమయం (t) = దూరం / సాపేక్ష వేగం

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          గణనలు:

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          The correct answer is MnCl₂, Cl₂, and 2H₂O.

                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                          • The reaction given is: MnO2+4HCl→MnCl2+Cl2+2H2OMnO2+4HCl→MnCl2+Cl2+2H2OMnO2+4HCl→MnCl2+Cl2+2H2O .
                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                          • Manganese dioxide (MnO₂) reacts with hydrochloric acid (HCl) to produce manganese(II) chloride (MnCl₂), chlorine gas (Cl₂), and water (H₂O).
                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                          • This is a type of redox reaction where MnO₂ is reduced and HCl is oxidized.
                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                          • The balanced chemical equation confirms the products as MnCl₂, Cl₂, and H₂O.
                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                          • In the context of redox reactions, MnO₂ acts as an oxidizing agent, and HCl acts as a reducing agent.
                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                          • Oxidation-Reduction Reactions (Redox Reactions)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                            • These reactions involve the transfer of electrons between two species.
                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                            • Oxidation refers to the loss of electrons, while reduction refers to the gain of electrons.
                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                          • Balancing Chemical Equations\n\t
                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                            • Balancing involves making sure that the number of atoms for each element is the same on both sides of the equation.
                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                            • It ensures that the law of conservation of mass is obeyed.
                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                          • Properties of Chlorine Gas (Cl₂)\n\t
                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                            • Chlorine gas is greenish-yellow and has a pungent odor.
                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                            • It is used in water treatment and as a disinfectant.
                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                            \n\t
