                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The distance between the centre of curvature and the pole of a mirror is called the radius of curvature (R).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The focal length (f) of a spherical mirror is related to its radius of curvature (R) by the formula: f = R/2.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In the given question, the focal length of the convex mirror is 1m.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Using the formula f = R/2, we can calculate the radius of curvature as: R = 2f = 2 × 1 = 2m.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Thus, the distance between the centre of curvature and the pole of the convex mirror is 2m.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Total number of observations (n) = 15 (which is an odd number).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Arrange in ascending order: 20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 23, 25, 30, 31, 32, 35, 41, 42, 43.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  For odd n, Median = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th observation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Median = (16 ÷ 2)th = 8th term.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Scanning the sorted list, the 8th term is 25.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ∴ The correct answer is 25.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Given observations: 20, 23, 25, 30, 20, 31, 32, 35, 20, 41, 42, 43, 20, 20, 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  If n is odd: Median = Value of ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th term.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ Step 1: Arrange the data in ascending order:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 23, 25, 30, 31, 32, 35, 41, 42, 43

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ Step 2: Count the number of observations (n):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  n = 15

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ Step 3: Calculate Median position:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Position = (15 + 1) ÷ 2 = 16 ÷ 2 = 8th term

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ Step 4: Identify the 8th term in the sorted list:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Sorted Data [8] = 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ∴ The correct answer is 25.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Median for Even Data

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  If the number of observations (n) is even, the median is the average of the (n ÷ 2)th and ((n ÷ 2) + 1)th terms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Mode of Data

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The mode is the observation that appears most frequently. In the given set, the mode is 20 (appears 6 times).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Empirical Relationship

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The relationship between central tendencies is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Mean Calculation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The Mean is calculated as the Sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations (n). Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  प्रेक्षणों की कुल संख्या (n) = 15 (जो एक विषम संख्या है)।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  आरोही क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें: 20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 23, 25, 30, 31, 32, 35, 41, 42, 43.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  विषम n के लिए, माध्यिका (Median) = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)वां प्रेक्षण।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  माध्यिका = (16 ÷ 2)वां = 8वां पद।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  क्रमबद्ध सूची को देखने पर, 8वां पद 25 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ∴ सही उत्तर 25 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  दिए गए प्रेक्षण: 20, 23, 25, 30, 20, 31, 32, 35, 20, 41, 42, 43, 20, 20, 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  यदि n विषम है: माध्यिका = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)वें पद का मान।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ चरण 1: आंकड़ों को आरोही क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 23, 25, 30, 31, 32, 35, 41, 42, 43

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ चरण 2: प्रेक्षणों की संख्या (n) गिनें:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  n = 15

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ चरण 3: माध्यिका की स्थिति की गणना करें:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  स्थिति = (15 + 1) ÷ 2 = 16 ÷ 2 = 8वां पद

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ चरण 4: क्रमबद्ध सूची में 8वें पद की पहचान करें:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  क्रमबद्ध आंकड़े [8] = 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ∴ सही उत्तर 25 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  सम आंकड़ों के लिए माध्यिका (Median)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  यदि प्रेक्षणों की संख्या (n) सम है, तो माध्यिका (n ÷ 2)वें और ((n ÷ 2) + 1)वें पदों का औसत होती है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  आंकड़ों का बहुलक (Mode)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  बहुलक वह प्रेक्षण है जो सबसे अधिक बार आता है। दिए गए सेट में, बहुलक 20 है (जो 6 बार आता है)।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  आनुभविक संबंध (Empirical Relationship)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  केंद्रीय प्रवृत्तियों के बीच संबंध इस प्रकार दिया गया है: बहुलक = 3 × माध्यिका − 2 × माध्य।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  माध्य (Mean) की गणना

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  माध्य की गणना सभी प्रेक्षणों के योग को प्रेक्षणों की कुल संख्या (n) से विभाजित करके की जाती है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n25b:T9b7,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The correct answer is Amoeba.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Amoebas are unicellular organisms known for their ability to change shape.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • They move and ingest food by extending their cell membrane to form pseudopodia (false feet).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The constant change in shape helps them navigate through their environment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Amoebas use their flexible shape to engulf food particles in a process called phagocytosis.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Their shape-shifting ability is crucial for their survival, allowing them to adapt to varying conditions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  పరిశీలనలు 20, 23, 25, 30, 20, 31, 32, 35, 20, 41, 42, 43, 20, 20 మరియు 20

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  మధ్యగతం అనేది సంఖ్యల జాబితాలోని మధ్య విలువ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  మొదట, డేటాను ఆరోహణ క్రమంలో అమర్చండి: 20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 20, 23, 25, 30, 31, 32, 35, 41, 42, 43

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  పరిశీలనల మొత్తం సంఖ్య (n) = 15

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  n బేసి సంఖ్య కాబట్టి, మధ్యగతం (n + 1) / 2 స్థానంలోని విలువ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ (15 + 1) / 2 = 16 / 2 = 8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ మధ్యగతం 8వ పరిశీలన

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  8వ పరిశీలన 25

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ∴ సరైన సమాధానం 2వ ఎంపిక.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
